content: Mɨkɨ niuki mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: «Tewi pemunu'aya keneutakexi, nekamatinitaxatɨamɨkɨ».
Netikuxaxatɨwakaku, 'Iyari nehetsie kaninuani, 'akaneniutaketɨani, kaneniupitɨani nemi'eniekakɨ kemɨ'ane mɨnetikuxaxatɨwakai.

Mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: «Tewi pemunu'aya 'ixaheritsixi wahetsɨa nekamenanunɨ'amɨkɨ. Mɨkɨ nuiwari memɨkaheu'enana mepɨhɨkɨ mekaneniuku'eirieni. Mɨkɨ meta meripai miemete watutsima mekaneniuku'eirieni, 'anatɨtɨ mepɨkanetsiha'eriwa.
Ne nematsinɨ'a teɨteri memɨkaheu'enana memɨtsetse'i wahetsɨa, mɨpaɨ pemɨtiwarayehɨtɨanikɨ: “Yawé naimekɨmɨyɨwe mɨpaɨ kanaineni”.
Heiwatɨ mematsihe'enieni, yatɨ hawaikɨ, yemekɨ teɨteri 'axamemɨte'u'iyari mekanihɨkɨtɨni, peru tsikere mɨpaɨ mepɨtemaika kename Kakaɨyari niukameya wahamatɨa 'uyeika.

'Ekɨ, tewi pemunu'aya, pepɨkawarayemakaka meta waniuki pepɨkamakaka, tsepa xuyatsata meta witsaxatsata pemuwe, tsepa terɨkaxi watsata pemuyeika. Pepɨkaheumaka kememɨtekuxatani, teɨteri memeuyexɨri mekanihɨkɨtɨni.
Heiwatɨ mematsi'u'enieni, yatɨ hawaikɨ, yemekɨ teɨteri 'axamemɨte'u'iyari mekanihɨkɨtɨni, peru neuxei 'ekɨ neniuki pepɨwataxatɨani.
'Ekɨ, tewi pemunu'aya, keneu'ena kenematitahɨawe, meta 'axapepɨkatiuka'iyarini wahepaɨ. Keneutakwa'i kenanukaxɨwa tita nematimini».
Hikɨ nemeutanierixi, mamá nepuxei xapa kwikwiekame 'akwekame nehepa hetatserame.
Nehɨxie pitawenaxɨ, mɨkɨtsie naitsata pɨraye'utɨkatei, kememɨteyuhiwerie, kememɨte'uka'eniwa meta kememɨtenanaimarie.
